title: Phantom Trading Co. — Signal Interchange Format v1
description: Canonical schema for inter-agent signal communication. All agents MUST emit signals in this format. Aligns with TradingSignal in src/types/trading.ts.

signalId.description: Unique signal identifier. Maps to TradingSignal.id

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC when the signal was generated

source.description: Agent role that generated the signal. Maps to TradingSignal.source

pair.description: Trading pair in ccxt format. Maps to TradingSignal.asset. Example: 'BTC/USDT:USDT'

direction.description: Trade direction. Maps to TradingSignal.direction (TradeDirection type)

confidence.description: Signal confidence 0-100. Maps to TradingSignal.confidence. Min 60 for pipeline acceptance.

strategyId.description: Unique strategy identifier. Maps to TradingSignal.strategyId

strategyName.description: Human-readable strategy name. Maps to TradingSignal.strategy

regime.description: Market regime at signal time. Must match MarketRegime type exactly.

regimeSource.description: How regime was determined. 'api' = from GET /api/market/regime (canonical). 'agent-computed' = agent's own ADX calculation. Prefer 'api' always.

entry.description: Target entry price. Maps to TradingSignal.entry

stopLoss.description: Stop-loss price. Required for all signals. Maps to TradingSignal.stop

targets.description: Take-profit levels [TP1, TP2, ...]. Maps to TradingSignal.targets

triggerDetails.description: What conditions triggered entry. Maps to TradingSignal.triggerDetails. Example: 'RSI crossed above 30, MACD histogram crossed 0, EMA8 crossed EMA21'

invalidation.description: What would invalidate this signal before entry. Example: 'RSI drops below 25' or 'Price breaks below $60K'

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC when signal becomes stale. Maps to TradingSignal.expiresAt. Max 24h for EFR/LSR, 8h for FRC.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe the signal was computed on

tier.description: Asset tier for position sizing. Major: BTC/ETH. Mid-cap: SOL/LINK/DOT/AVAX/ARB/OP. Small-cap: everything else.

fundingRate.description: Funding rate data, if relevant to the signal (required for FRC, optional otherwise)

type.description: CRITICAL: 'predicted' = next funding estimate (not yet settled). 'settled' = last executed funding payment. FRC v1.0 requires 3 consecutive SETTLED negatives.

consecutiveNegativeSettled.description: Count of consecutive settled negative periods. FRC trigger requires >= 3.

positionSizing.description: Pre-calculated position sizing at current equity

riskPercent.description: Risk per trade as decimal (e.g., 0.015 for 1.5%)

examples.triggerDetails: RSI crossed above 30, MACD histogram improving, EMA(8) approaching EMA(21)
examples.invalidation: RSI drops below 25 or price breaks below $0.110

pipelineRules.requiredFields: All 'required' fields must be present or signal is auto-rejected
pipelineRules.regimeSourcePreference: Agents MUST use 'api' (GET /api/market/regime) when available. 'agent-computed' only as fallback.
pipelineRules.fundingRateRule: For FRC signals, fundingRate object is REQUIRED with type='settled' and consecutiveNegativeSettled >= 3. Predicted rates inform analysis only, never trigger entries.
